summary: std/x509: PEM text is read in linear time with Go's pem.Decode rules (GO-2025-4009, CVE-2025-61723)
details: PEM text is read in linear time with Go's pem.Decode rules (GO-2025-4009, CVE-2025-61723); a long run of BEGIN lines took quadratic time, and near-PEM text Go refuses (missing base64 padding, a wrong END line) was accepted. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/x509, std/tls, std/http; native backends): PEM text is read in linear time with Go's pem.Decode rules (GO-2025-4009, CVE-2025-61723); a long run of BEGIN lines took quadratic time, and near-PEM text Go refuses (missing base64 padding, a wrong END line) was accepted. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
